environment.description: FastAPI service running on ECS Fargate in us-east-1, behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/app-service-role) has SecretsManager:GetSecretValue and DynamoDB:PutItem permissions. No permission boundary attached. ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 8000. No WAF attached to the ALB. Session cookies are set with httponly and samesite=lax but the /init-session endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication.

config.network: public ALB -> private subnet ECS tasks
